A '''Reptavi-cam''' was a type of [[Camera/Legends|camera]] mounted on a [[Unidentified reptavian species|native]] [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] of the [[Unidentified farming moon|farming moon]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Reptavi-cam was used by ''[[The Coruscant Holo Net]]'' to capture images of a [[Battle on an unidentified farming moon|battle]] on the [[Farm/Legends|farming]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
